data_fields.donor_constant: number; >0 one-shot timer, -1 Ready button (Tutorial.js:61 comment, 63-66)

best_idea: Quest steps as an ordered list where each step listens only to its own server-emitted events, advances only when its guard holds, and restores from the step index without re-running setup.
decision_why: Take the ordered step list, per-step guards and restore rule, but change the advance source: in Frankendom only server-emitted events (confirmed kill, ledger write, zone entry) move a step, and a client ready answer only counts while the server has the step waiting.
acceptance: Server test: a three-kill quest advances only after three server-confirmed kill events; a client ready sent while the step is not waiting is refused and the step is unchanged; after reload the player sees each finished step's text once and the current step's init does not run again.
